name: TownePlace Suites (Draper, UT) Warm Oatmeal Station with Brown Sugar & Fresh Banana
brandOrRestaurant: TownePlace Suites Salt Lake City Draper
whyItWorks: Warm rolled oats provide gut-soothing soluble fiber (beta-glucan) that forms smooth stool bulk without scratching. Sliced fresh banana provides natural potassium.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle hot oatmeal into a bowl, stir in a spoonful of brown sugar, and slice a fresh ripe banana on top (pass on almonds and dried cranberries).
watchOuts: Skip whole almonds, walnuts, and granola toppings if stricturing
